shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents a hidden rear edge of the cube, behind the sphere in the drawing. Right image: It is an auxiliary perpendicular projection segment used to construct a right triangle.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashed projection ends at an explicit right-angle foot on the base, establishing a planar perpendicular construction. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
